shared_elements: animal or bird forms in profile
linear repeated sign or pattern band
relief-style outline figures with internal detail
justification: The main shared content is only broad: profile animal/avian forms and rows or bands of repeated linear signs. The largest difference is that A centers on a standing winged bird-headed anthropomorphic figure interacting with a stylized tree, while B is a stacked register of separate animals and abstract signs with no comparable figure, tree, or ritual interaction.
